Libra Internship Program 2027 Application

Application deadline

Application deadline: November 15, 2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants must be a currently enrolled university student.
  • Applicants must be at least 18 years old.
  • International students are eligible.

Financial Support

  • This is a paid internship.
  • We pay round-trip flights.
  • Visa fees are paid.
  • Housing support may be available depending on location.

Everything You Need To Apply

Submit a CV and university transcript.
